ios.desc:
If you can describe it, you can listen to it.

Lissin turns any topic, question or set of sources into a personal audio show made just for you. Create a podcast, story, song, or deep dive. Get one episode or schedule a recurring show.

WHAT YOU CAN POINT IT AT

YouTube channels, newsletters, websites, RSS feeds, subreddits, podcasts, X (Twitter), Product Hunt, and Hacker News. Plus any link, article, PDF, document, or image you hand it.

Lissin researches the topic, monitors your sources, writes the script, and designs the voices. You get something ready to listen to, without chasing updates or putting it together yourself.

MAKE ALMOST ANYTHING LISTENABLE

Go deep on any topic. Turn current events into a podcast. Create suspenseful stories, bedtime adventures, personalized reflections or calming audio. Even turn research into a song.

Try ideas like:

DEEP DIVE
“Explain why casinos make you lose track of time, like a con artist revealing the trick.”

PODCAST
“Break down this week’s biggest movie release as two critics who completely disagree.”

SONG
“Research this week’s AI funding news and turn it into a rap song.”

STORY
“Create a nightly bedtime story about a dragon who is scared of fire.”

PERSONAL WELLNESS
“Create a calming 10-minute reflection based on what has been making me feel overwhelmed this week.”

MAKE IT PERSONAL

Tell Lissin about your interests, preferences, goals, or current situation. Add the sources and context you want it to use, or connect supported accounts such as Gmail.

Lissin uses the context you choose to provide to shape the research, script, editorial direction, voice, and delivery.

The result is not just recommended to you but made just for you.

YOU DECIDE HOW IT THINKS AND SOUNDS

Tell Lissin what to notice, what to question, and how to frame the topic. Choose a first-principles view, a skeptical take, a practical breakdown, a debate, or your own editorial lens.

Then decide how it sounds. Choose the language, accent, voice, pacing, and energy. Make it calm, conversational, analytical, dramatic, playful, or something entirely your own. Lissin supports multiple languages and accents.

FRESH EPISODES, WITHOUT STARTING OVER

Create a one-time episode whenever inspiration strikes, or schedule a show to return daily, weekly, or every two weeks.
